Use the BCR iperf module for network benchmarks

Build the benchmark image from the standard iperf3 module so Bazel
owns its source selection, configuration and dependencies. Package
the static executable and upstream notices on the shared helper base,
preserving the image name and client/server placement.

Use iperf3's JSON sender summary for aggregate throughput across all
streams and keep the requested transfer budget in KiB. This replaces
the first-stream text metric; results are not directly comparable with
iperf2. Keep the explicit port and buffer size, and remove iperf2's
best-effort realtime scheduling request.
